{{Short description|Austrian mathematician (1924–1994)}}
[[File:Karl Prachar.jpg|thumb|right|'''Karl Prachar''', Wien 1967]]
'''Karl Prachar''' ({{IPA|de|ˈpʁaçaːɐ̯|lang|De-at Karl Prachar.ogg}}; 1924 &ndash; November 27, 1994) was an Austrian mathematician who worked in the area of [[analytic number theory]]. He is known for his much acclaimed book on the distribution of the [[prime number]]s, ''Primzahlverteilung'' (Springer Verlag, 1957).

Prachar received his [[doctorate]] in 1947 from the [[University of Vienna]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=61846}}</ref>
